test_title: PYST 23: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

Neither of the solutions (1)/ appear satisfactory (2)/ to the panel (3)/ reviewing the case. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "appear" in part 2 is incorrect as the subject "Neither" is singular.
 
• When the subject is singular, the verb must also be singular to maintain subject-verb agreement.
 
• The correct verb should be "appears" instead of "appear."
 
• Therefore, the error is in part 2 of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Neither of the solutions appears satisfactory to the panel reviewing the case."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "Neither of the solutions"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3: "to the panel"** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "reviewing the case."** – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
